name: Aminatou
aliases: the child who spins cocoons of fate
description: Aminatou is a young girl and planeswalker whose magic revolves around fate, shown as wispy moths, and who is known for her fateshifter tokens.

timeline.summary: Proft creates an artificial Omenpath to Duskmourn and rescues the party from Valgavoth.
timeline.quote: Proft successfully created an artificial Omenpath to Duskmourn by using his mind magic in combination with Kaito’s spark, Aminatou’s abilities, and a piece of wood from the House that Kaito had provided.

citation.work: Alquist Proft
citation.text: "Alquist Proft", section "The Omenpath Project". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Niv-Mizzet reveals that a girl called Aminatou has already arrived, saying the team will need her help; Niko recognizes the name.
timeline.quote: A young girl, younger than Zimone here, who calls herself Aminatou.

citation.work: Duskmourn: House of Horror | Episode 1: Don't Go Past the Old Dark House
citation.text: "Duskmourn: House of Horror | Episode 1: Don't Go Past the Old Dark House " by Mira Grant. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 19 Aug 2024.

timeline.summary: At the door, researchers surround it; Aminatou recoils in fear and warns that it hears them.
timeline.quote: Aminatou gasped and recoiled as her eyes locked on the door.

citation.work: Duskmourn: House of Horror | Episode 1: Don't Go Past the Old Dark House
citation.text: "Duskmourn: House of Horror | Episode 1: Don't Go Past the Old Dark House " by Mira Grant. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 19 Aug 2024.

timeline.summary: Aminatou explains her fateshifters, which rewind a fatal choice once, and says anyone refusing them will not come back.
timeline.quote: When you make a choice that would lead to your certain death, everyone nearby who holds a token will see the outcome

citation.work: Duskmourn: House of Horror | Episode 1: Don't Go Past the Old Dark House
citation.text: "Duskmourn: House of Horror | Episode 1: Don't Go Past the Old Dark House " by Mira Grant. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 19 Aug 2024.

timeline.summary: Aminatou hands out the fateshifter tokens, giving the Wanderer a second.
timeline.quote: She handed them around the members of the team, giving the Wanderer a second.

citation.work: Duskmourn: House of Horror | Episode 1: Don't Go Past the Old Dark House
citation.text: "Duskmourn: House of Horror | Episode 1: Don't Go Past the Old Dark House " by Mira Grant. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 19 Aug 2024.

timeline.summary: The Wanderer asks Aminatou to mind Yoshimaru while the team goes in.
timeline.quote: Will you mind Yoshimaru for me?

citation.work: Duskmourn: House of Horror | Episode 1: Don't Go Past the Old Dark House
citation.text: "Duskmourn: House of Horror | Episode 1: Don't Go Past the Old Dark House " by Mira Grant. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 19 Aug 2024.

timeline.summary: The door slams shut behind the team as Aminatou, Etrata, Proft and Niv-Mizzet watch.
timeline.quote: Then the door closed, and the House was all.

citation.work: Duskmourn: House of Horror | Episode 1: Don't Go Past the Old Dark House
citation.text: "Duskmourn: House of Horror | Episode 1: Don't Go Past the Old Dark House " by Mira Grant. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 19 Aug 2024.

timeline.summary: The vision shatters as the Wanderer clutches Aminatou's fateshifter, having narrowly averted the choice.
timeline.quote: the vision shattered as the Wanderer gasped, hand going to the pocket where she had tucked Aminatou's fateshifter

citation.work: Duskmourn: House of Horror | Episode 4: Don't Give Up
citation.text: "Duskmourn: House of Horror | Episode 4: Don't Give Up" by Mira Grant. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 26 Aug 2024.

timeline.summary: Aminatou says the House now knows Kaito and does not want him inside.
timeline.quote: The trouble isn't in you. It's in the House.

citation.work: Duskmourn: House of Horror | Episode 5: Don't Give In
citation.text: "Duskmourn: House of Horror | Episode 5: Don't Give In" by Mira Grant. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 28 Aug 2024.

timeline.summary: Kaito explains the artificial Omenpath is made of his spark, Proft's mind magic, Aminatou's fate-twisting and a piece of the House.
timeline.quote: My spark, Proft's mind magic, Aminatou's fate-twisting, and a piece of the House that I took with me when I had to planeswalk away.

citation.work: Duskmourn: House of Horror | Episode 6: Don't Die
citation.text: "Duskmourn: House of Horror | Episode 6: Don't Die" by Mira Grant. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 30 Aug 2024.

timeline.summary: Back on Kamigawa, Nashi tells children the story of their adventure.
timeline.quote: watching as Nashi spun the story of their adventures to a crowd of rapt youngsters.

citation.work: Duskmourn: House of Horror | Episode 6: Don't Die
citation.text: "Duskmourn: House of Horror | Episode 6: Don't Die" by Mira Grant. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 30 Aug 2024.

timeline.quote: Her spark ignited at a young age

timeline.quote: Aminatou reassured Kaito that his spark was still intact

timeline.summary: Proft creates an artificial Omenpath using Kaito's spark and Aminatou's abilities, and Kaito and Proft rescue Nashi and the others from Valgavoth.

timeline.quote: Nashi told of their adventures to an enthralled group of children

citation.work: Aminatou

timeline.summary: Aminatou gives each rescuer a fateshifter on Ravnica.
timeline.quote: the group was assisted by Aminatou , who gave each rescuer a fateshifter, a crystallized measure of her power over fate.

citation.text: "Niko Aris", section "On Duskmourn". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.quote: By looking into her future, she saw her Spark would eventually ignite and opted not to wait.
